supportingSources.text: At 1 automatically own one Anacite Drone: AC 13+INT modifier, HP 5+INT modifier+class level (minimum 1), flight 30 ft, ranged bolt 60 ft attack PB+INT for 1d6 piercing. Bonus Action commands one move and one attack or named module action; otherwise it Dodges and may follow you. On bolt hit roll d4; on 4 target CON save or cannot take Reactions through end next turn (Shock, no automatic Stun). All drones/turrets/scraplings share ONE damaging action per Bonus Action command per regular turn unless a card explicitly supplies a priced extra attack. No autonomous barrage. Drone is a construct, not immune to all conditions; poison/psychic immunity, no charm. Carry/retract it in 1 minute; no pocket extra world or passenger flight.

A destroyed drone remains 0 HP until repaired for 1 RP and 10 minutes with tools to half HP, once/short rest, or rebuilt during long rest to full. Ordinary repairing does not recharge devices, grant organic healing or trigger destruction bonuses. At 13 Dual Drone Protocols automatically chooses on each long rest either 2 basic drones each with one module, or one drone with 2 distinct modules. Still one command budget. Never more than 2 drones.
